H0733G.name: Arah
H0733G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0733G.short: Arah, the son of Shual ('Ulla'), was a descendant of Asher.

H0733H.name: Arah
H0733H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0733H.short: Arah, whose daughter was married to Shechaniah, was the father-in-law of Tobiah the Ammonite.

H0733I.name: Arah
H0733I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0733I.brief: A Jewish leader whose daughter married Tobiah's son.
H0733I.short: Arah's daughter was married to the son of Tobiah the Ammonite.

H0758J.name: Aram
H0758J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0758J.brief: Son of Shemer, descendant of Asher
H0758J.short: Aram was a descendant of Asher, mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H0758G.name: Aram
H0758G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0758G.brief: Son of Shem, ancestor of the Arameans
H0758G.short: Aram, a son of Shem and ancestor of the Aramean people.

H0758H.name: Aram
H0758H.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0758H.brief: Son of Kemuel, nephew of Abraham
H0758H.short: Aram was the son of Kemuel, who was the son of Abraham's brother Nahor.

H0761G.name: Aramitess
H0761G.desc: Woman living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0761G.brief: Concubine of Manasseh; mother of Asriel
H0761G.short: An Aramitess, who was a concubine of Manasseh, gave birth to Machir and Asriel..

H0765.name: Aran
H0765.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0765.brief: Son of Dishan, descendant of Seir the Horite
H0765.short: Aran was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau's family and the Horite clans.

H0704.name: Arba
H0704.brief: Father of Anak, former name of Hebron
H0704.short: Arba was the father of Anak and the namesake of Kiriath-arba, which was the former name of Hebron.

H0757.name: Archites
H0757.brief: Inhabitants of a region near Bethel
H0757.short: The Archites were a people group mentioned in relation to the boundaries of Ephraim's territory and as the origin of Hushai, King David's friend and advisor.

H0714G.name: Ard
H0714G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0714G.brief: Son of Benjamin, brother of Bela
H0714G.short: Ard, a son of Benjamin, is listed among the descendants of Jacob who went to Egypt during the famine.

H0714H.name: Ard
H0714H.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0714H.brief: Grandson of Benjamin, son of Bela
H0714H.short: Ard, a grandson of Benjamin, is mentioned in the census of the Israelites taken in the wilderness of Moab.

H0715.name: Ardon
H0715.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0715.brief: Son of Caleb, brother of Jether and Mered
H0715.short: Ardon was a son of Caleb, mentioned in the genealogy of Judah.

H0709H.name: Argob
H0709H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0709H.brief: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
H0709H.short: Argob, along with Arieh, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

H0742.name: Aridai
H0742.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0742.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
H0742.short: Aridai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

H0743.name: Aridatha
H0743.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0743.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
H0743.short: Aridatha was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

H0745.name: Arieh
H0745.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0745.brief: Officer of King Pekahiah of Israel
H0745.short: Arieh, along with Argob, was with King Pekahiah when Pekah conspired against him and assassinated him.

H0739.name: Ariel
H0739.desc: Warriors living at the time of Exile and Return
H0739.brief: Two lion-like men of Moab killed by Benaiah
H0739.short: Ariel refers to two lion-like men of Moab who were killed by Benaiah, one of David's mighty warriors.

H0740G.name: Ariel
H0740G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0740G.brief: One of the leaders summoned by Ezra
H0740G.short: Ariel was one of the leaders summoned by Ezra to assist in the return of the exiles to Jerusalem.

H0746B.name: Arioch
H0746B.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0746B.short: Arioch, the captain of King Nebuchadnezzar's guard, was commanded to execute the wise men of Babylon but brought Daniel before the king to interpret his dream.

H0746A.name: Arioch
H0746A.desc: King living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0746A.brief: King of Ellasar, ally of Chedorlaomer
H0746A.short: Arioch, king of Ellasar, was one of the four kings who joined forces with Chedorlaomer in the battle against the five kings of the plain.

H0747.name: Arisai
H0747.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H0747.brief: Son of Haman, enemy of the Jews
H0747.short: Arisai was one of the ten sons of Haman, who were killed and hanged after their father's downfall.

H0764.name: Armoni
H0764.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0764.brief: Son of Saul by Rizpah, killed by Gibeonites
H0764.short: Armoni was a son of Saul by his concubine Rizpah, killed by the Gibeonites (<ref="2Sa.21.8">2Sa.21.8</ref>).

H0770.name: Arnan
H0770.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0770.short: Arnan was a descendant of David's son Solomon (<ref="1Ch.3.21">1Ch.3.21</ref>).
H0770.meaning: “lion of perpetuity: or a wild goat: I shall shout for joy”

forms.meaning: “lion of perpetuity: or a wild goat: I shall shout for joy”

H0720.name: Arod
H0720.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0720.brief: Son of Gad and founder of the Arodite clan
H0720.short: Arod, son of Gad, was the founder of the Arodite clan (<ref="Gen.46.16; Num.26.17">Gen.46.16; Num.26.17</ref>).

H0775.name: Arpachshad
H0775.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0775.brief: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham
H0775.short: Arpachshad, son of Shem, was born two years after the flood and was an ancestor of Abraham (<ref="Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36">Gen.10.22,24; 11:10-13; 1Ch.1.17-18,24; Luke 3:36</ref>).
H0775.meaning: “I shall fail as the breast: he cursed the breast-bottle”

forms.meaning: “I shall fail as the breast: he cursed the breast-bottle”

H0783A.name: Artaxerxes
H0783A.desc: Artaxerxes Longimanus, an emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
H0783A.brief: Persian king during Ezra and Nehemiah's time
H0783A.short: Artaxerxes was the Persian king who allowed Ezra and Nehemiah to return to Jerusalem (<ref="Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14">Ezra 7:1,11-12,21; Neh.2.1; 5:14</ref>).
H0783A.meaning: “I will make the spoiled to boil: I will stir myself (in) winter”

forms.meaning: “I will make the spoiled to boil: I will stir myself (in) winter”
“I will make the spoiled to boil: I will stir myself (in) winter”

H0721.name: Arvadites
H0721.brief: Canaanite descendants of Canaan, son of Ham
H0721.short: The Arvadites were a Canaanite People from Canaan, son of Ham (<ref="Gen.10.18; 1Ch.1.16">Gen.10.18; 1Ch.1.16</ref>).

H0777.name: Arza
H0777.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H0777.brief: Steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah
H0777.short: Arza was the steward of King Elah's household in Tirzah (<ref="1Ki.16.9">1Ki.16.9</ref>).

H0788.name: Ashbel
H0788.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H0788.brief: Son of Benjamin, founder of the Ashbelite clan
H0788.short: Ashbel was a son of Benjamin and the founder of the Ashbelite clan (<ref="Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1">Gen.46.21; Num.26.38; 1Ch.8.1</ref>).
H0788.meaning: “a man in God: a man of Baal: fire of Bel: I will make a path”

forms.meaning: “a man in God: a man of Baal: fire of Bel: I will make a path”
“a man in God: a man of Baal: fire of Bel: I will make a path”

H0790.name: Eshban
H0790.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H0790.brief: Son of Dishon, a Horite chief in Seir.
H0790.short: Eshban was a son of Dishon and a Horite chief who lived in the land of Seir.

H0767.name: Oren
H0767.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0767.short: Oren was a son of Jerahmeel, a descendant of Judah.

H0771.name: Ornan
H0771.desc: Man living at the time of United Monarchy
H0771.brief: Jebusite, sold threshing floor to David
H0771.short: Ornan (Araunah) was a Jebusite who sold his threshing floor to King David, which later became the site of Solomon's temple.

forms.meaning: “I shall shout for joy” = “make ye to shine” (

H0758K.name: Aram-maacah
H0758K.short: Aram-maacah was an Aramean kingdom that allied with the Ammonites against David.

H0763H.name: Aram-naharaim
H0763H.brief: A region mentioned in the title of Psalm 60.
H0763H.short: Aram-naharaim, a region David fought against, as referenced in Psalm 60's title.

H0760.name: Aram-zobah
H0760.brief: A region mentioned in the title of Psalm 60.
H0760.short: Aram-zobah, a region David fought against, as referenced in Psalm 60's title.

H0780.name: Ararat
H0780.brief: A mountain range where Noah's ark rested after the flood.
H0780.short: Ararat, the mountain range where Noah's ark came to rest after the flood.

H0709G.name: Argob
H0709G.brief: A region in Bashan, known for its fortified cities.
H0709G.short: Argob, a region in Bashan, conquered by the Israelites and known for its many fortified cities.

H0769.name: Arnon
H0769.brief: A river and valley, serving as a boundary for Israel.
H0769.short: The Arnon, a river and valley that marked the boundary between Moab and the Amorites, later serving as Israel's southern border.

H0774.name: Arpad
H0774.short: Arpad was a city in northern Syria conquered by the Assyrians.

H0700.name: Arubboth
H0700.brief: A district in Israel under Solomon's rule.
H0700.short: Arubboth, a district governed by one of Solomon's twelve officers.

H0725.name: Arumah
H0725.brief: A city associated with Abimelech and King Jehoiakim's mother.
H0725.short: Arumah or Rumah, a city mentioned in connection with Abimelech's reign and as the hometown of King Jehoiakim's mother.

H0719.name: Arvad
H0719.brief: An island city, known for its skilled mariners and soldiers.
H0719.short: Arvad, an island city whose inhabitants served as sailors and soldiers for Tyre.

H0795.name: Ashdod
H0795.brief: A major Philistine city, known for Dagon worship.
H0795.short: Ashdod or Azotus, one of the five major Philistine cities, was a center of Dagon worship and a target of prophetic judgment.

H0751.name: Erech
H0751.brief: Ancient Mesopotamian city; part of Nimrod's kingdom
H0751.short: Erech, an ancient Mesopotamian city that was part of Nimrod's kingdom and later inhabited by people who opposed the rebuilding of the Jerusalem Temple.

H0763G.name: Mesopotamia
H0763G.brief: The region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers
H0763G.short: Mesopotamia, the ancient region between the Tigris and Euphrates rivers, where Abraham lived before being called to Canaan (<ref="Genesis 24:10; Act.7.2">Genesis 24:10; Act.7.2</ref>) and where the Israelites were oppressed by Cushan-rishathaim (<ref="Judges 3:8">Judges 3:8, 10</ref>).

H0758I.name: Syria
H0758I.brief: Ancient region north of Israel, often in conflict
H0758I.short: Syria, an ancient region north of Israel, often engaged in conflicts with Israel and Judah (<ref="1Kgs. 20:1; 2Kgs. 13:3">1Kgs. 20:1; 2Kgs. 13:3</ref>).
